The keeper sat back, salt wind stinging his cheeks, and resolved to track down the sailor’s relatives to deliver the long-lost message.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在薄蓝的夜色里，鳞次栉比的楼宇只余零星几扇窗亮着暖黄的灯，像散落在黑丝绒上的碎金。主干道上没了白日的车水马龙，只有穿橙马甲的环卫工默默扫着昨夜落下的梧桐叶。24小时便利店的灯牌亮得透亮，玻璃门偶尔被晚归的人推开，漏出几声模糊的交谈。风裹着江边的湿意吹过，带着淡淡的栀子花香，整座城市还在沉睡，只有少数醒着的人在等第一缕天光。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a problem solves a tiny piece of itself first, then passes the remaining smaller problem to the exact same process.\n- Every recursive process has a clear stopping rule, so it knows when to stop splitting the problem and start putting answers together.\n- For example, to count Russian nesting dolls, you open one, count 1, then use the same rule on the smaller doll inside until you reach the smallest solid doll."}
